dedupe_keys.name: ipcc ar6 sea level projections and nasa sea level projection tool

description: This dataset holds the sea level projections of the IPCC Sixth Assessment Report: the full set of samples for the global projections and summary relative sea level projections, with and without the AR6 estimate of background vertical land motion, whose confidence output files correspond most directly to the figures and tables of the report. The NASA Sea Level Projection Tool lets users view global and regional projections from 2020 to 2150 for five Shared Socioeconomic Pathway scenarios, relative to 1995 to 2014, click any ocean point for its local projection and the contributions of individual physical processes, and download the data in several formats. The projections were produced by G. G. Garner, T. Hermans, R. E. Kopp and co-authors with the Framework for Assessing Changes To Sea-level (FACTS) and published on Zenodo (version 20210809, about 19 GB in three ZIP archives) under CC BY 4.0; users must cite AR6 WGI chapter 9, the FACTS paper and the dataset version. Caveats: only processes that can be projected with at least medium confidence are included, the full archives are large, and the providers give no warranty. It is a core scenario input for coastal hazard exposure, flood defence capacity planning and climate adaptation of coastal infrastructure; related records are the Climate Central Coastal Risk Finder and the DIVA coastal impact model.
